caption: The drawing depicts a pair of pointed, slip-on shoes placed side by side, with the left shoe partially overlapping the right. The shoes are rendered in shades of brown, with visible stitching along the edges. Each shoe features a decorative green band that wraps over the upper part and is fastened with a bow made of green ribbon. The interior of the shoes shows a hint of red and tan, with the right shoe displaying a visible red insole decorated with a white spiral pattern. The background is plain and untextured, colored off-white or beige, with no other objects present in the composition. The shadows under the shoes add depth to the image.
title: Lady's Overshoes
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
